answer: Task sets the class-based service pattern but not helper placement. The three are today private methods (promote.py:91,104,165) used only inside the promoted flow, so DrawerService methods preserve intent; module-level functions are equally workable. Executor decides and notes it.

Today _inbox_to_drawer_task returns int and prints inside (promote.py:30-70). 'run prints what the service returns' needs a new type (e.g. dataclass: exit code + lines). No test observes promote stdout, so the executor picks the type and preserves exit codes 0/1.

Already stated: move the logic 'minus its printing' and have run print the service result. _inbox_to_drawer_task has 7 print() calls (promote.py:33,36,44,65,67,68,69); _untrack_note returns its warning as a string, not a print.

In-repo lazy pattern: operations.py:347 `self._spec_registry: SpecRegistry | None = None` plus @property at operations.py:373-377 loading on first access. Use the same cached-attribute+property shape for the DrawerService handle.

DRAWER_INDEX_FILES is defined at operations.py:549 and used only at operations.py:572; repo-wide grep finds no importer (tests included). It moves entirely into DrawerService; no re-export needed in operations.py.

attach_drawer_source (operations.py:583-592) returns {**payload, 'from_drawer': <repo-relative posix path>} and never mutates. Sole caller cli/commands/operations.py:27; tests use the CLI. Done When omits it but Scope makes it a one-line wrapper too.

In code: promote.py:91 `_resolve_unique(self, directory, selector) -> Path | list[Path] | None`; None if dir/matches missing, Path if one, list if many (exact name/stem first, then case-insensitive stem substring). The move is mechanical.
_read_markdown (promote.py:104-115) is called only at promote.py:39 inside _inbox_to_drawer_task; no other use anywhere. It moves entirely into the service; operations.py's unrelated _read_doc stays.

PromoteCLI has no __init__ and is built as PromoteCLI() (cli/main.py:129-131); root comes from args.root in run (promote.py:24-25). So DrawerService(root) is constructed per call inside run/_inbox_to_drawer_task, not injected or cached.

Convention: subpackage __init__ re-exports with __all__ (deskops/graph/__init__.py:1-19; deskops/models/__init__.py:23-46). services/__init__.py should re-export DrawerService in __all__, not stay empty.
Task requires no new tests: a pure move whose contract is the named tests plus F1 contract tests run unmodified. Service-level unit tests are optional; the existing suite is the acceptance criterion.

F2 defines the boundary: store writes (untrack) go through doc_io/DocTransaction; plain file writes that do not touch the store are out of scope (task-rw-f2-transactional-doc-io.md:47). F2 already lists promote.py:86 as a migrated write site.

Locators verified current: DRAWER_INDEX_FILES operations.py:549, resolve_drawer_source :551, attach_drawer_source :583. '15 domains' is S2 of runs/planning/deskops-rewrite-inventory.md (operations.py 2,913 lines, one class).
